notes: Apply to an apktool-decoded project. Every patch is anchor-verified; the applier aborts if a patch does not match exactly the expected number of times.

patches.description: Stop forcing EXISTING_WIFI back to MANUAL in v(Context).
Stop forcing EXISTING_WIFI back to MANUAL in z(Context, WirelessHotspotMode).
Fall back to BluetoothAdapter.getName() when the Geely hop returns null (requireCarHopRadioName).
